design_notes: 26 questions, balanced over categories: cardinality-violation 3, chained-realization 4, defined-class-realization 5, disjointness-violation 7, orthogonality-control 4, subsumption-transitive 3. Each question is derived mechanically from an axiom pattern of the reference ontology (paper Section 4.3); terms follow reference_ontologies/naming_contract.md. Frozen before the runs.

cqs.nl: A reading with systolic 110 and diastolic 70 is inferred to be Normal Blood Pressure (systolic <120 defined band - the 'father' case on the datatype axis).
A reading with systolic 135 is inferred to be Stage 1 Hypertension (130-139 defined band).
A reading with systolic 150 is inferred to be Stage 2 Hypertension (140-179 defined band).
A reading with systolic 145 and diastolic 85 is inferred to be Isolated Systolic Hypertension (two-axis defined class: systolic >=140 AND diastolic <90).
A reading with systolic 130 and diastolic 95 is inferred to be Isolated Diastolic Hypertension (two-axis defined class: systolic <140 AND diastolic >=90).

An individual asserted only as a Renal Artery Stenosis is inferred to be a Secondary Cause (3-hop asserted taxonomy: individual -> RenalArteryStenosis -> RenovascularDisease -> RenalCause -> SecondaryCause).
An individual asserted only as a Primary Aldosteronism is inferred to be a Secondary Cause (asserted taxonomy: PrimaryAldosteronism -> EndocrineCause -> SecondaryCause).
An individual asserted only as Hyperthyroidism is inferred to be a Secondary Cause (deep asserted taxonomy: Hyperthyroidism -> ThyroidDisease -> EndocrineCause -> SecondaryCause).
An individual asserted only as a Cotton-Wool Spot is inferred to be Target-Organ Damage (deep asserted taxonomy: CottonWoolSpot -> RetinalFinding -> HypertensiveRetinopathy -> TargetOrganDamage).
Left Ventricular Hypertrophy is a Target-Organ Damage (2-hop asserted chain: LeftVentricularHypertrophy < HypertensiveHeartDisease < TargetOrganDamage).
Renal Artery Stenosis is a Secondary Cause (3-hop asserted chain: RenalArteryStenosis < RenovascularDisease < RenalCause < SecondaryCause).
A Dihydropyridine is an Antihypertensive (2-hop asserted chain: Dihydropyridine < CalciumChannelBlocker < Antihypertensive).
A reading cannot be both Normal Blood Pressure and Stage 1 Hypertension (categories are a disjoint partition of BloodPressureCategory).
Hypertension cannot be both Primary and Secondary (disjoint union of Hypertension).
A drug cannot be both an ACE inhibitor and an Angiotensin Receptor Blocker (antihypertensive classes are pairwise disjoint).
A secondary cause cannot be both a Renal Cause and an Endocrine Cause (secondary-cause kinds are pairwise disjoint).
A hypertensive crisis cannot be both a Hypertensive Emergency and a Hypertensive Urgency (organ-damage vs no-organ-damage; disjoint severity states).
A reading cannot be both Isolated Systolic Hypertension and Isolated Diastolic Hypertension (dual-axis bridge phenotypes are disjoint on the systolic axis: >=140 vs <140).
A single individual cannot be both a Blood Pressure Reading (a measurement) and a Hypertension (a disease) - top-level kinds are disjoint.
A reading cannot have two different systolic values (hasSystolicValue is functional / exactly-one).
A reading cannot be classified into two distinct categories (hasBloodPressureCategory is functional).
setup: ht:y21 a ht:BloodPressureReading ; ht:hasBloodPressureCategory ht:cat1 , ht:cat2 .

cqs.nl: A single hypertension diagnosis cannot carry two competing guideline systolic thresholds (hasDiagnosticSystolicThreshold is functional; ACC/AHA 130 vs ESC/JNC 140 clash) - the corpus's central threshold controversy.

A reading with systolic 145 and diastolic 85 that qualifies as both Stage 2 Hypertension and Isolated Systolic Hypertension is a legitimate, satisfiable model - Stage2 and ISH are orthogonal, not disjoint.
A primary hypertension treated with an ACE inhibitor is a legitimate model (the treatment relation between Hypertension and Antihypertensive must be satisfiable).

A secondary hypertension with a renal secondary cause and hypertensive nephropathy as target-organ damage is a legitimate multi-axis model (hasSecondaryCause + hasTargetOrganDamage co-occur without clash).
setup: ht:o25 a ht:SecondaryHypertension ; ht:hasSecondaryCause ht:rc25 ; ht:hasTargetOrganDamage ht:tod25 .

cqs.nl: An individual asserted as a Hypertensive Emergency yields a consistent model - the cross-cutting severity class is satisfiable (consistency-sensitive control: flips to inconsistent iff a configuration makes HypertensiveEmergency unsatisfiable).
